# LpDetailPage2: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `LpDetail2Elements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

- **"Business Email Address *" / "Email"**: email field. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /en/lp/isg-digital-sustainability-2025). In `LpDetail2Elements` as `BUSINESS_EMAIL_ADDRESS_INPUT`: `enter().businessEmailAddress(...)`.
- **"Company/Organization Name *" / "Company"**: text field. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /en/lp/isg-digital-sustainability-2025). In `LpDetail2Elements` as `COMPANY_ORGANIZATION_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().companyOrganizationName(...)`.
- **"Job Title" / "SF_Job_Title__c"**: text field. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /en/lp/isg-digital-sustainability-2025). In `LpDetail2Elements` as `JOB_TITLE_INPUT`: `enter().jobTitle(...)`.
- **"Submit"**: button. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /en/lp/isg-digital-sustainability-2025). In `LpDetail2Elements` as `SUBMIT_BUTTON`: `click().submit()`.
